response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software developer with strong general engineering craftsmanship, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or hardware-software co-design, which are core requirements for this Principal Performance Architect role focused on AI hardware and cloud infrastructure optimization.
strengths: Long, diverse professional track record with senior/staff titles
Some low-latency, high-performance systems experience (async I/O, fibers, real-time databases in DLang)
Demonstrated ability to mentor, teach, and lead technical workshops
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture background
No hardware-software co-design or chip design collaboration experience

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
